duplicate_detection.detail: Horizontal tile merge + NMS IoU=0.5 leaves residual overlapping person boxes; product view showed every detection as a box.

gt_and_prediction_dual_boxes.detail: portable_final_media.build_portable_proof_mp4 draws all prediction boxes plus GT Track7 outline each frame; target gets yellow pred + green GT dual box. Matching colors (cyan/red/yellow) encode eval status, not team identity.

multiple_track_ids_same_player.detail: _SimpleIoUTracker assigns a new ID on brief misses; no confirmed/tentative gate; unconfirmed short tracks drawn as full tracks.

track_id_switch.detail: Lightweight IoU tracker; ID switches not fully MOT-evaluated in prior pilot (marked not_evaluable).

short_false_positives_as_confirmed.detail: No min-hit confirmation; every frame detection rendered as a track box.

referee_gk_player_role_mix.detail: Roles never assigned in proof overlay; GT class_id=-1 only.

team_assignment.detail: Team kit clustering exists in identity/ but was not run or overlaid on final proof.

ball_detector.detail: Proof pipeline never invoked ball adapter; TeamTrack GT has no ball class (class_id=-1 only) so ball accuracy not evaluable from GT.
